# Sendforsign

> Your agent drafts. People sign. Contracts, e-signature and an audit trail for AI agents, inside your product, via MCP or API. An agent builds a contract from a template, fills in its own fields, lets each recipient fill theirs, sends it for e-signature and gets a webhook when it is signed. White-label and multi-tenant, with agent modes, send confirmations and an audit log. Simple electronic signatures for the EU and the US.

## Docs

- [AI agents](https://sendforsign.com/docs/ai-agents/overview): MCP server quickstart (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code), headers, tools, modes and audit log
- [MCP quickstart](https://sendforsign.com/docs/ai-agents/mcp-quickstart): connect Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, OpenAI Agents SDK
- [Agent skill](https://sendforsign.com/docs/ai-agents/skills): SKILL.md recipes for drafting, filling and sending contracts
- [API introduction](https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/introapi): authentication with X-Sendforsign-Key, clientKey and userKey
- [Docs home](https://sendforsign.com/docs/introduction)

## Pages

- [E-signature MCP server](https://sendforsign.com/mcp): tools, OAuth sign-in, modes, confirmations, audit log
- [eSignature API](https://sendforsign.com/esignature-api): REST API for contracts, templates, PDF, recipients, webhooks
- [Embedded e-signing](https://sendforsign.com/embedded-esignature): React components, white-label signing
- [Blog](https://sendforsign.com/blog): e-signature, embedded contracts, AI agents

## Endpoints

- REST API: https://api.sendforsign.com/api/
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 sign-in or X-Sendforsign-Key header): https://api.sendforsign.com/mcp
- App and API keys: https://app.sendforsign.com
